claims.text: The authentication activity originating from 195.129.24.210 and 218.188.2.4 both show repeated authentication failures, but the pattern of these failures differs between the two groups.

The group from 195.129.24.210 shows a burst of activity on two separate days, with 11 consecutive authentication failures occurring on July 1, and 4 failures on June 30, all within a short period of time.
In contrast, the group from 218.188.2.4 shows a single burst of activity on June 15, with 12 consecutive authentication failures occurring within a short period of time.

However, the group from 195.129.24.210 shows a more prolonged period of repeated failures, with two distinct bursts of activity separated by a day, whereas the group from 218.188.2.4 shows a single, shorter burst of activity.
These repeated failures without a corrective action in between suggest that the authentication activity from 195.129.24.210 may be more suspicious than that from 218.188.2.4.
